field_contracts.provider_registry: provider registry entries declare provider id, capability, fixture key, schema ref, auth policy, terms metadata, and network defaults without importing provider SDKs
field_contracts.request_envelope: request envelopes normalize operation, query, pagination cursor, cache policy, fixture key, and replay key
field_contracts.response_envelope: response envelopes carry status, data, metadata, provenance, and normalized errors in a stable provider-free shape
field_contracts.pagination: pagination metadata records cursor fields, next cursor, page size, and deterministic replay order
field_contracts.rate_limit: rate-limit metadata records quota windows, retry-after hints, and fixture-only throttling policy
field_contracts.auth_redaction: auth redaction records redacted field names and proves secret values are absent
field_contracts.cache_retry_policy: cache/retry policy records ttl, retryable status, max attempts, and deterministic backoff metadata
field_contracts.provenance: provenance records fixture source, captured/as-of timestamps, source schema, and replay readiness
field_contracts.error_envelope: error envelopes normalize provider, network, credential, validation, and clean-skip failures
field_contracts.clean_skips: clean skips return skipped envelopes for absent SDK, absent credential, or disabled network states
